name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '_33' is the per-event handler-table dispatch index (0x33) from the table at 0x51B91 (data_fd2_battle_ai_post_action_consequence_table), a meaningful domain ID, not address residue. '__unref_drop' descriptor reflects that the only xref is the DATA table slot (no tile-step / turn-event hook references it -> unreferenced/cut content) and that it performs a battle item drop. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Unreferenced chapter event-handler slot 0x33: drop one inline battle item to the stepping char, then show dialog page 3.
logic_summary: Copies the inline 3-byte drop entry data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_33_drop_entry_inline (00 65 00 = byte type 0 ITEM + ushort value 0x0065 = item id 101, Teleport Staff) onto the stack, calls fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(stepping_char_id, 1, &entry) to award it to the recipient, then calls fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=3, 0xA0000, 320, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). In the binary the dialog call is a tail-merge: after pushing its 8 args the function does JMP 0x34FB7, falling into the PUSH current_chapter_text; CALL fd2_display_dialog_scene; ADD ESP,0x24 tail hosted in fd2_chapter_event_handler_27__ch15_eye_gem_drop @ 0x34F74. The source encodes the functionally-exact self-contained dialog call; the tail-merge is a pure binary size optimisation. Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1, __CHK frame 0x34.

params.name: stepping_char_id
params.semantics: Tile-step ABI arg (the stepping char id) forwarded unchanged as the recipient_idx of the dropped item to fd2_process_battle_drop_entries; selects which runtime char receives the item.
params.reason: Accurately reflects the dispatch-table tile-step ABI argument and its use as the drop recipient. No address residue, not a generic param_N.

returns.semantics: No return value. Tail-jumps into the shared display_dialog tail of handler 27 which performs the dialog call + stack cleanup + RET.

reads_globals: data_fd2_chapter_event_handler_33_drop_entry_inline (0x52748, inline 3-byte drop entry: byte type + ushort value)
data_fd2_current_chapter_text (current chapter FDTXT pointer, passed to fd2_display_dialog_scene)
comment_original_issue: Source comment was accurate; minor imprecision: 'value=0x65' could read as a single byte. Clarified that the drop entry is byte type + ushort value (matching fd2_process_battle_drop_entries' entry layout), named item id 101 = Teleport Staff, and noted stepping_char_id is forwarded as the recipient.
notes: 0 direct callers (callers query returns none); only xref is the DATA handler-table slot at 0x51C5D (per-event table @ 0x51B91, dispatch idx 0x33). Entry layout confirmed from fd2_process_battle_drop_entries decomp: each entry = byte type + ushort value; type 0 = ITEM with value as item id. Item 0x65 = 傳送法杖 (Teleport Staff) per fd2-knowledge. JMP-to-shared-tail (0x34FB7, handler 27 @ 0x34F74) verified via disassembly. Plate already accurate and consistent with refined source understanding -> left unchanged.
